beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — the last part of the HAI wordmark. Three moves: a marquee loop at three speeds — slow, medium, fast — every letter flying in from scattered positions and rotations to land as the full wordmark, and the exit family. How the HAI wordmark loops, how it assembles from nothing, and how it leaves.

Your turn. Paste this: scatter every glyph in HUMANITARIANS AI to a random position and rotation, then spring them all home into the wordmark — and tell me the right duration. Too fast reads as a snap. Too slow reads as chaos. The right duration reads as intention.
H A I wordmark, in motion. Part five. All nineteen. Liam, in for Bear.
